'''B-4R''' was a [[Bartender droid/Legends|bartender droid]] present at the [[Drunkard's Vote]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] located in the [[Senate Commercial District]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Encounter" /><ref name="Date">{{DynamicDate|Understaffed|Coruscant}}</ref>
